name: Samsung SDS Suwon Data Center
notes: Samsung SDS official office/infrastructure page lists Suwon Data Center at 10 Samsung-ro 168beon-gil, Yeongtong-gu, Suwon-si; Samsung SDS data-center service page lists Korea locations including Suwon.

name: K Square Data Center Uijeongbu / Uijeongbu Rhythm City AI data center
notes: Press reports identify a 100MW two-building AI/hybrid cloud data-center project in Uijeongbu, around Sangok-dong/Rhythm City, with Koramco as developer; later Maeil Business coverage says Koramco is still pursuing the Uijeongbu Rhythm City 100MW project.

name: NH Integrated IT Center, Uiwang
developer: NH NongHyup; Hyundai E&C construction reference
notes: Hyundai E&C project page locates NH Integrated IT Center in Uiwang and describes two buildings including a data center and development center; BIkorea describes it as a large NH group data center in Uiwang.

name: Hyundai AutoEver Uiwang Data Center
notes: Hyundai AutoEver official domestic workplace page lists an Uiwang Data Center at 37 Cheoldobangmulgwan-ro, Uiwang-si.

name: Yangju Defelix Holdings 40MW data center
notes: Yangju City signed an MOU with Defelix Holdings to promote a 40MW-class data-center project, targeted for completion by 2032; sources describe city support for permitting and local high-tech industry attraction.

name: Yangpyeong-gun bid for Naver second data center
notes: Yangpyeong-gun submitted an expression of interest for Naver's second data-center site and reportedly proposed about 171,000 sqm of land; Naver ultimately selected a different location, so this is recorded as a failed attraction bid rather than an active project.

name: Yeoju-si bid for Naver second data center
notes: Yonhap reported Yeoju-si submitted a bid to attract Naver's second data center at city-owned land around Sanggeo/Ha-geo-dong; local follow-up reported Yeoju was not selected for further talks.

name: Yeoncheon AI/Green Bio green data center concept
notes: Local press coverage of Yeoncheon's 'AI and Green Bio future growth city' initiative says the county plans a green data center to integrate agricultural, climate, and ecological data; no hyperscale facility, site, MW, or delivery schedule was found.

name: Pacific Sunny Data Center, Jukjeon, Yongin
developer: Pacific Asset Management; CPPIB; Shinhan Financial Investment; Hyundai E&C construction
notes: Hyundai E&C announced completion of the Jukjeon, Yongin hyperscale data center, citing 64MW IT load, 100MW receiving capacity, two data-center buildings, and KRW 1.3 trillion project value.

name: DC Connects Soul01 / Warburg Pincus Yongin hyperscale data center
developer: DC Connects; Warburg Pincus; Wide Creek AMC
notes: Warburg Pincus and partners announced groundbreaking for an 80MW hyperscale data center on a greenfield Yongin City site, with DC Connects website referenced as 56MW IT capacity across two buildings and RFS targeted by 2027.

name: Daou IDC Jukjeon CDC
notes: Daou IDC official page describes its first large carrier-neutral data center at Jukjeon-dong 23-11/12/13, Yongin, with construction starting in H1 2024, completion scheduled for H2 2026, 40MW receiving capacity, and 24MW IT load up to 26MW.

name: Export-Import Bank of Korea IT Center, Yongin
notes: Korea Times reported Export-Import Bank opened its own IT center on the grounds of its training institute in Yongin; Maeil Business earlier described relocation of the headquarters data center to the new Yongin facility.

name: Deokseong-ri Data Center in Yongin
developer: Private developer; Heerim Architects design reference; Samsung C&T construction order reference
notes: Heerim lists a privately developed Deokseong-ri data-center complex in Yongin with three buildings and design/completion reference; Samsung C&T Q2 2026 transcript references a KRW 0.5 trillion Deokseong-ri Data Center in Yongin order.

name: Andong dam-water AI data center cluster attraction plan
notes: Yonhap reported Andong City is pursuing AI data-center attraction using Andong and Imha dam water for cooling, with site surveys in H2 2026 and a target to apply for cluster designation approval in 2029 for 2030 designation.
